subject: Shared roadmap: success signals & verification suite for trial
messages:
From: Evan Holt <evan.holt@elliotdynamics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, camila_reyes@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial roadmap — defining success signals

Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our stakeholders liked the latency profiles and the RBAC options. Before we lock a trial start date we need a short, shared plan for how Elliot will judge success. Procurement also wants visibility into how we’ll measure the trial for the 60-day POC.

High-level asks from Elliot:
- Clear go/no-go checkpoints tied to business outcomes (reduction in latency on live queries, FTE time saved for triage).
- A reproducible verification suite we can run against our dataset.
- Minimal instrumentation to confirm data isolation (logs & audit).

Can your team propose a compact verification suite (smoke + one-week regression set) and a success-signal ladder that maps to our procurement acceptance? Evan, Jordan in procurement are looped.

Thanks,
Evan

--
Evan Holt
Head of AI Ops, Elliot Dynamics
From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
To: Evan Holt <evan.holt@elliotdynamics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, camila_reyes@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial roadmap — defining success signals

Evan —

Appreciate the context. Attached is a concise proposal: a Success Signal Matrix (XLSX) plus a short Verification Suite spec (MD) that we can run with your test dataset. Summary below.

Proposal (summary):
1) Success Signal Ladder (high level):
  - Signal A (Safety & Privacy): KMS-integrated keys + audit log sampling — pass threshold: full audit trace for 100 sampled requests over 72 hrs.
  - Signal B (Latency SLO): median < 120ms for single-turn generation (50–75th percentile), 95th < 400ms during expected traffic pattern.
  - Signal C (Throughput): 95% of inference requests succeed under target concurrency (configurable; we’ll use your baseline of 60 concurrent workers).
  - Signal D (Quality): concordance on a 200-sample prompt set — automated fuzz + 20 manual spot checks. Pass if automated score >= 0.78 and manual review shows no critical failures.

2) Verification Suite:
  - Smoke tests (on deploy): connectivity, model routing check, K/V cache priming.
  - Regression harness (weekly): run 200-sample prompt set, compare embeddings and generation metrics vs baseline commit.
  - Instrumentation checks: log retention, redaction markers, role-based access confirmation.

3) Go/No-Go cadence:
  - Day 0: baseline capture — run suite against current traffic for 48 hrs.
  - Day 7: preliminary pass/fail (allow one remediation sprint).
  - Day 30: final assessment for procurement sign-off (evidence journal linked).

Attachments: 20260712-success-signal-matrix.xlsx, verification-suite-specs.md

Next steps: Ben will propose a concrete test-run schedule (can you confirm a preferred trial window next week?) and Camila will partner on the quality checks.

Talk soon —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.example.com
To: Evan Holt <evan.holt@elliotdynamics.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.example.com, jordan.mills@elliotdynamics.com, procure+ed@elliotdynamics.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial roadmap — defining success signals

Evan / Jordan —

Thanks — proposed concrete cadence below. Please confirm windows and owners; I’ll book the turn-key runs on our side.

Proposed trial schedule (one-month POC, condensed):
- Week 0 (Prep, < 3 days): access, KMS test key exchange, dataset landing (S3 pre-signed). Owner: Elliot IT + Redwood infra (Ben).
- Week 1 (Baseline runs, 48–72 hrs): run verification suite, capture baseline traces. Deliverable: evidence journal + smoke-pass artifacts. Owner: Elliot (run), Redwood (support).
- Week 2 (Remediation sprint): performance tuning (batching, cache warm-up), fix obvious blockers. Deliverable: tuned profile + rerun results. Owner: Redwood infra + Camila for quality scenarios.
- Week 3 (Stress & quality): run extended regression harness and manual spot-checks. Deliverable: report + sampled transcripts.
- Week 4 (Assessment & signoff): assemble the pass/fail ledger for procurement. If all mandatory signals pass -> procurement signoff & path to Dedicated capacity trial.

Acceptance thresholds (mandatory):
- Security: evidence of encrypted-at-rest and audit trails for 72 hrs sample.
- Latency: median < 120ms; 95th < 400ms during benchmark window.
- Quality: automated concordance >= 0.78 on the 200-sample set; <= 2 critical errors in manual review.

Jordan / Procurement: if the above looks reasonable, please confirm what additional artifacts you require for procurement acceptance (e.g., SOC2 evidence, AUP statement).

I’ll provision the test IDs and share an infra checklist once we have a confirmed start date.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@elliotdynamics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com, camila_reyes@redwood.example.com
Cc: Evan Holt <evan.holt@elliotdynamics.com>, procure+ed@elliotdynamics.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial roadmap — defining success signals

Marissa / Ben —

This is helpful and aligns with Procurement’s expectations. A couple of clarifications before we lock the start date:
1) For the security artefacts, we need a short letter confirming retention window & redaction behavior for PII during the trial. A one-page statement is sufficient.
2) Can Redwood commit to a single remediation sprint (Week 2) being the formal scope for fixes prior to final signoff? Anything outside that sprint will be tracked separately.
3) Please include a runbook snippet that shows who to contact for a failed smoke test (pager/rotation).

If you can update the Verification Suite spec with those three items I can sign off and route to procurement for timeline approval. Goal: start on Monday 20 Jul if everything is green.

Jordan

--
Jordan Mills
Senior Procurement Manager, Elliot Dynamics
